mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.9% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where UNRATE falls below 4.9%, or the return distribution in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 2.04 million units signals strong household demand and rising consumer confidence, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite HOUST above 2.04 million, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 119.678 signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating business conditions, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases where INDPRO falls below 119.678, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures and residential construction starts indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or the joint signal fails to generate a positive average return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 196.1 combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where CPIAUCSL exceeds 196.1 and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment growth and decline in unemployment rate signals a labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 133999.0 and UNRATE is below 4.9%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 11088.6 billion chained dollars signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 falls below 11088.6, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
